# Film Connection Film School

> > Film Connection is a mentor-apprentice film school that places students directly inside real production companies for hands-on training and career placement support.

Film Connection offers an alternative to traditional film schools by combining practical education with industry networking. Students learn by working alongside professional filmmakers in actual production environments, with comprehensive career services and job placement assistance to help launch their careers in the film industry.

## Key Topics

- mentor-apprentice learning
- film production training
- hands-on film education
- job placement assistance
- career services
- film industry networking
- on-the-job training
- production company placement
- post-graduation support
- alternative film school
- practical filmmaking experience
- industry connections

## Career Services & Job Placement

- [Job Placement & Career Services](http://filmconnection.com/job-opportunities): Film Connection career services & job placement with mentor-apprentice support
